explication: YTSage is a PySide6 desktop downloader. The principal workflow is: a user supplies a URL, the GUI analyzes it, presents available formats and playlist choices, launches a configured yt-dlp download, applies optional subtitle/audio/video post-processing, and records the result in history. Settings, localization, cookies, proxies, SponsorBlock, generic sites, and update/runtime detection extend that flow. The graph reflects sampled entry points and documented capabilities; some GUI orchestration is inferred from module names and excerpts, so uncertain internal calls are omitted.
